item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Firewall for Containers
item.description:
Azure Firewall for Containers is in public preview. It extends Azure Firewall protections to containerized workloads so network traffic for container environments can be secured and managed centrally.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: OS-level dependency support via containers for Azure Functions Flex Consumption
item.description:
Azure Functions Flex Consumption now has preview support for OS-level dependencies via containers. This lets apps extend the Microsoft-managed worker environment with native executables and system libraries.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: visualstudio: What Would You Build in Azure If You Didn’t Have to Ask for a Budget First?
item.description:
The post says eligible Visual Studio subscribers may already have access to a personal Azure sandbox, making it easier to try .NET apps, serverless, containers, proofs of concept, or unfamiliar Azure services without requesting a budget first.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog
